planets.name: HAT-P-19 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HAT-P-19 with a 4.01-day year, found in 2010.

text.card: HAT-P-19 b was found in 2010 by HATNet as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HAT-P-19. Its orbit and size follow Kang et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname KANG_ET_AL_2024): disc_year 2010, disc_facility HATNet, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 4.00878322, pl_radj 1.008, pl_bmassj 0.277

thermal.facility: Spitzer Space Telescope satellite Infrared Array Camera (IRAC)
thermal.source: Kammer et al. 2015, dayside brightness temperature at 3.6 µm (NASA Exoplanet Archive emission table)
thermal.chosen: 2 measured of 2 rows; the smallest relative uncertainty, then the longest wavelength
